findings.description: Removing the already_bracketed check means an optional parameter whose metavar already has brackets (e.g. a Choice type returning "[a|b]") is wrapped again, producing "[[a|b]]" in help and usage output.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an optional option whose type's get_metavar returns a string starting with "[" and ending with "]", such as a Choice type. The condition now always adds brackets when not required, so the metavar becomes doubly bracketed. Impact: usage and help text render malformed doubled brackets for such options, a visible regression from the prior output.
